'''September 2000 Green Bay tournament (2 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at HobbyTown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin on 2 September 2000. Christian K. won it. It is known from Mark Kloida's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1203">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-gb-9-2-00d1203/ gb-9-2-00], DeckTech (Mark "yodarth" Kloida, 5 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-05-gb-9-2-00d1203/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2000
* '''Site:''' HobbyTown USA, Green Bay, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' Christian K.
